# Load data

```{r}
load("../../data/clinical.rds")
load("../../data/microbiome_metadata.rds")
load("../../data/counts-long.rds")
load("../../data/ra-long.rds")
```

# Prepare data

```{r}
# Could create a pre-filter for microbes present in less than 4 samples 
pres <- counts.l %>%
  filter(sample %in% mic.meta$sample) %>%
  group_by(Taxonomy) %>%
  summarize(pres = sum(est.reads > 0)) %>%
  mutate(microbe = str_extract(Taxonomy, "[^|]+$")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Taxonomy) 

model.in <- counts.l %>%
  mutate(microbe = str_extract(Taxonomy, "[^|]+$")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Taxonomy) %>%
  right_join(mic.meta) %>%
  left_join(demographics) %>%
  # create binary outcome var
  mutate(response.bin = ifelse(Response == "Responder", 1, 0),
  # make days numeric
         Days = as.integer(Days)) %>%
  rename(Patient_Id = `Patient Id`) %>%
  filter(!grepl("t__", microbe)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = microbe, values_from = est.reads, values_fill = 0) %>%
  filter(sample %in% mic.meta$sample)

model.in.ra <- ra.l %>%
  right_join(mic.meta) %>%
  left_join(demographics) %>%
  # create binary outcome var
  mutate(response.bin = ifelse(Response == "Responder", 1, 0),
  # make days numeric
         Days = as.integer(Days)) %>%
  rename(Patient_Id = `Patient Id`) %>%
  filter(!grepl("t__", microbe)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = microbe, values_from = RelAbun, values_fill = 0) %>%
  filter(sample %in% mic.meta$sample)

lib.size <- counts.l %>%
  filter(Taxonomy %in% c("k__Bacteria","k__Archaea")) %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarize(library.size = sum(est.reads))

model.in <- model.in %>% 
  left_join(lib.size) 

microbes <- colnames(model.in)
microbes <- microbes[grepl("__", microbes)]
microbes.ra <- colnames(model.in.ra)
microbes.ra <- microbes.ra[grepl("__", microbes.ra)]
```

```{r}
# truly random selection
overlap <- intersect(microbes, microbes.ra)
random.test.mics <- sample(overlap, min(10, length(filtered_mics)))

# selected microbes for testing 
test.mics <- c("s__Alistipes_finegoldii",  "s__Lachnospiraceae_bacterium_AM48_27BH", "s__Intestinimonas_massiliensis","f__Barnesiellaceae", "s__Phascolarctobacterium_faecium", "g__Dialister", "s__Bifidobacterium_longum")
```

# Run models

```{r}
# Function to fit models
fit_models <- function(x, model.in, model.in.ra) {
  model_formula_off <- as.formula(paste0(x, " ~ Response*Days + offset(log(library.size))"))
  model_formula <- as.formula(paste0(x, " ~ Response*Days"))

  models <- list(
    # FZINBMM (Counts)
    "ZINBMM_Offset" = glmm.zinb(model_formula_off, data = model.in, random = ~ 1 | Patient_Id, zi_fixed = ~1, zi_random = NULL),
    # FZINBMM w/ AR1
    "ZINBMM_AR1" = glmm.zinb(model_formula_off, data = model.in, random = ~ 1 | Patient_Id, zi_fixed = ~1, zi_random = NULL, correlation = corAR1()),
    # FZINBMM w/ no offset
    "ZINBMM" = glmm.zinb(model_formula, data = model.in, random = ~ 1 | Patient_Id, zi_fixed = ~1, zi_random = NULL),
    # ZIGMM (RA)
    "ZIGMM" = lme.zig(model_formula, data = model.in.ra, random = ~ 1 | Patient_Id, zi_fixed = ~1, zi_random = NULL),
    # ZIGMM w/ AR1
    "ZIGMM_AR1" = lme.zig(model_formula, data = model.in.ra, random = ~ 1 | Patient_Id, zi_fixed = ~1, zi_random = NULL, correlation = corAR1()),
    # ZIGMM w/ CAR1
    "ZIGMM_CAR1" = lme.zig(model_formula, data = model.in.ra, random = ~ 1 | Patient_Id, zi_fixed = ~1, zi_random = NULL, correlation = corCAR1()),
    # ZIGMM w/ ARMA
    "ZIGMM_ARMA" = lme.zig(model_formula, data = model.in.ra, random = ~ 1 | Patient_Id, zi_fixed = ~1, zi_random = NULL, correlation = corARMA(p = 1, q = 1))
  )

  return(models)
}

# Compute model metrics
compute_metrics <- function(model, observed) {
  # mse = mean of (error)^2
  predictions <- predict(model, type = "response")
  residuals_sq <- (predictions - observed)^2
  mse <- mean(residuals_sq, na.rm = TRUE)
  rmse <- sqrt(mse)

  # define n and p 
  n <- length(observed)
  p <- length(coef(model))
  
  # variance of residuals
  sigma2 <- sum(residuals(model)^2) / (n - p)
  
  # Loglik 
  logLik <- -(n/2) * (log(2*pi*sigma2) + 1) - sum(residuals(model)^2) / (2 * sigma2)

  # number of estimate params..i think k should be 6 ?
  # + random intercept and zi intercept 
  k <- length(coef(model)) + 2
  aic <- (2 * k) - (2 * logLik)
  bic <- (log(n) * k) - (2 * logLik)

  return(c(MSE = mse, RMSE = rmse, AIC = aic, BIC = bic, LogLik = logLik))
}

# Loop over microbes
results <- list()
for (x in test.mics) {
  models <- fit_models(x, model.in, model.in.ra)

  model_metrics <- lapply(names(models), function(model_name) {
    # Use the correct observed dataset
    observed <- if (grepl("GMM", model_name)) model.in.ra[[x]] else model.in[[x]]
    compute_metrics(models[[model_name]], observed)
  })

  model_metrics <- do.call(rbind, model_metrics)
  rownames(model_metrics) <- names(models)

  results[[x]] <- model_metrics
  print(paste("Microbe:", x))
  print(model_metrics)
}

# Combine all results into a single data frame
final_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(results), function(m) {
  cbind(Microbe = m, results[[m]])
}))

final_results <- as.data.frame(final_results)
final_results[, -1] <- lapply(final_results[, -1], as.double)
final_results <- final_results %>% rownames_to_column("Model") %>%
  mutate(Model = gsub("\\.\\d+$", "", Model))

print(final_results)
```

# Save model metrics 

```{r}
write.csv(final_results, file = "../../data/model-metrics.csv", row.names = F)
final_results <- read.csv("../../data/model-metrics.csv")
```

# Visualize
```{r}
heatmap.in <- final_results %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, Microbe, MSE, AIC) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(Model, Microbe), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Score") %>%
  mutate(Microbe = substr(Microbe, 4, nchar(Microbe)))
```

Heatmap doesn't look that great, scales are too different per microbe 
```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(heatmap.in, Metric == "MSE"),
    aes(x = Microbe, y = Model, fill = Score)
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "darkred", high = "steelblue", name = "MSE") +
  new_scale_fill() +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(heatmap.in, Metric == "AIC"),
    aes(x = Microbe, y = Model, fill = Score)
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "darkred", high = "steelblue", name = "AIC") +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA)
  )

ggsave("../../figures/supplemental-model-metrics.png", height = 6, width = 8)
```
